_authoringNotes: WORK_ORDER_738 + WORK_ORDER_830 -- Echo specialization + affinity/synergy balance. Tunable knobs the owner re-tunes in playtest with NO recompile (loaded via CanonicalJson; the Resources copy wins, StreamingAssets is the desktop source -- keep the two byte-identical). Identity (name/element/affinity) stays in the EchoRosterCatalog CODE table; ONLY the numbers live here. OWNER RULING 2026-08-02 (F8 on the Echo card, 'should be +5% not 55%'): the per-echo readout showed +55% because the card prints base+match (0.15 + 0.40). Rescaled so a MATCHED echo at Lv 1 reads +5% (base 0.02 + match 0.03) and an UNMATCHED one reads +2% -- matching still pays 2.5x, so the affinity choice still means something. perLevelBonus dropped 0.05 -> 0.01 in the same breath: at the old value one level-up would have outweighed the entire matched bonus, which would have made the affinity pick cosmetic. Lv 8 matched now reads +12%. NOTE FOR THE OWNER: the synergy/set knobs below were NOT rescaled -- crossBonuses 0.10 each, hiddenTriSynergyBonus 0.25 and sixSetBonusGlobalHarvest 0.20 are now LARGE relative to a 0.05 per-echo contribution, so team composition now dominates individual assignment. That may be exactly what you want (it rewards collecting the set); say the word if they should scale down too. WO-830 history: preferredLaneMatchBonus was lowered 0.75 -> 0.40 for the all-matched reality (all 6 Echoes now prefer Harvest and the player picks each resource); crossBonuses are the 3 DISCLOSED pair synergies (both members owned + both harvesting their own affinity resource); hiddenTriSynergyBonus is the UNDISCLOSED bonus when all 3 pairs run at once -- applied to income only, NEVER shown in any readout. perEchoBaseRate doubles as the DumpSilos split weight per assigned resource: Bran+Maren (0.45 each) are the two Crystals harvesters and their COMBINED 0.90 stays below every other single affinity rate (food/gold 1.0, wood 1.1, iron 1.15) so crystals remain the slowest faucet (monetization guard, WO-830 Sec.3b).
